description: This file defines the OA_UpgradeLogger class, which provides logging functionalities for the upgrade process in the Revive Adserver project, including error and message logging, log file management, and error checking.

classes.name: OA_UpgradeLogger
classes.description: A class for managing logs during the upgrade process, including error and message logging, warning handling, and log file management.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Initializes the logger, setting the default log file path.

methods.name: setLogFile
methods.description: Sets the log file path and clears existing log if present.

methods.name: isPearError
methods.description: Checks if a result is a PEAR error and logs it if so.

methods.name: logClear
methods.description: Clears all logged messages and errors, resets warning and error flags.

methods.name: log
methods.description: Logs a message and writes it to the log file.

methods.name: logOnly
methods.description: Writes a message directly to the log file without storing in messages array.

methods.name: logWarning
methods.description: Logs a warning message and sets warning flag.

methods.name: logError
methods.description: Logs an error message and sets error flag.

methods.name: logErrorUnlessEmpty
methods.description: Logs an error message only if the message is not empty.

methods.name: _logWrite
methods.description: Handles the actual writing of messages to the log file or buffer.

methods.name: getLogfilesList
methods.description: Returns a list of log files matching a specific pattern in the logs directory.

methods.name: deleteLogFile
methods.description: Deletes the current log file if it exists.
